name: A10-0278/2026 – Nathalie Loiseau – Recital N – Am 16
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: N. whereas over 3.5 million Syrian refugees remain abroad, primarily in Türkiye, Lebanon, Jordan and Iraq, while over 7.4 million are internally displaced within Syria; whereas over 3 million refugees and internally displaced people have returned to their homes since December 2024; whereas a UNHCR survey indicates that 80 % of Syrian refugees in Lebanon, Jordan, Iraq and Egypt intend to return to Syria at some stage; whereas, of the nearly 1.4 million Syrians who applied for and, in most cases, were granted protection over the last decade, only a few thousand have returned to Syria since the end of the civil war; whereas German Chancellor Merz and Syrian transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa have recently pledged to repatriate a vast majority of the approximately one million Syrian nationals living in Germany;
